meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Manus-style persistent file-based planning for AI coding agents: keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk so work survives context loss and /clear. Use when asked to plan out, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用文件持久化任务计划，避免上下文丢失
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要规划多步骤任务并担心上下文丢失
copy.tagline_en: Persist task plans to files, survive context loss
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often plan multi-step tasks and worry about context loss

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会在磁盘上创建并维护三个文件：task_plan.md（任务计划）、findings.md（研究发现）和 progress.md（进度日志）。每次对话或执行工具后，它会自动更新这些文件，即使清空对话上下文，工作进度也不会丢失。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 规划、分解或组织一个多步骤项目、研究任务，或任何需要 5 次以上工具调用的工作时触发。也支持在 /clear 后自动恢复之前的会话。

say.text: 帮我规划一个多步骤项目，先创建 task_plan.md。
say.note: Claude 会创建任务计划文件并开始按步骤执行。

say.text: 把刚才的研究发现保存到 findings.md。
更新 progress.md，记录当前阶段完成情况。
say.note: Claude 会更新进度日志，标记已完成阶段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates and maintains three files on disk: task_plan.md (task plan), findings.md (research findings), and progress.md (progress log). It automatically updates these files after each conversation or tool execution, preserving work even after context is cleared.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project, research task, or any work requiring 5+ tool calls. Also supports automatic session recovery after /clear.

say_en.text: Plan a multi-step project and create task_plan.md first.
say_en.note: Claude will create the plan file and start executing steps.

say_en.text: Save the research findings to findings.md.
say_en.note: Claude will write key findings to findings.md.

say_en.text: Update progress.md with the current phase completion.
say_en.note: Claude will update the progress log marking completed phases.
